status: Four precise future-design corrections; original proposal preserved

Home_policy_choices_remaining.choice: Explicitly accept the refinement from preliminary all-string version wording to version_status plus unspecified null, or require a genuine publisher declaration before unversioned catalogue rows are pin-eligible. A normalizer default1 cannot satisfy either provenance choice.
Home_policy_choices_remaining.not_a_source_defect: The draft openly proposes the refinement; this peer does not grant Home policy approval.

Home_policy_choices_remaining.choice: Name the trusted raw/local/persisted catalogue and cache-provenance authorities, freshness policy and allowed SPACR_MODEL_DOWNLOAD values. Off remains non-overridable and metadata settings remain identity constraints, not acquisition URL authority.
Home_policy_choices_remaining.not_a_source_defect: No trust-store format or acquisition policy is implemented by the schema.

Home_policy_choices_remaining.choice: Finalize per-module model-input/backend registry, one-to-one migration map and treatment of retained inactive records. An inactive valid record may be retained only while its setting survives unchanged; it must not be consumed under an incompatible backend or trigger acquisition. Explicitly identify legacy sidecar/version fields that are model-bound rather than treating unrelated version settings as checkpoint lineage.
Home_policy_choices_remaining.not_a_source_defect: The draft recognizes these boundaries but no exhaustive registry/migration policy is delivered.
